definitions.standard_downs: First down, second-and-7 or less, third/fourth-and-4 or less
definitions.situational_splits: Historical-aligned regulation rush/pass EPA plays with valid start down, distance, clock, pre-play score; 38/28/22-point garbage cutoffs. Red-zone and leverage remain separate metrics and can overlap; never sum their counts.
definitions.script_early: First-half first/second-down regulation EPA plays outside garbage time; descriptive EPA per play, not a first-half spread.
definitions.leverage: Third/fourth down with 3+ yards to go in regulation outside garbage time; descriptive EPA per play.
definitions.stuff_rate: Share of rushes gaining zero or fewer yards
definitions.opportunity_rate: Share of rushes gaining at least four yards
definitions.line_yards: 120% of losses, 100% through 4 yards, 50% from 5-10, capped after 10
definitions.red_zone: Scrimmage plays at the opponent 20-yard line or closer
definitions.red_zone_scoring_rate: Share of red-zone drives producing any points
definitions.adjusted_sack_rate: Sacks per qualifying dropback after removing spikes and throwaways
definitions.available_yards: Share of starting drive field space gained, capped from 0% to 100%
definitions.third_down_delta: Actual third-down conversion rate minus the FBS expectation regressed from early-down success
definitions.fumble_recovery_delta: Team fumble recoveries minus a 50/50 recovery expectation
definitions.garbage_time: First half at 38+ points, third quarter at 28+ points, or fourth quarter at 22+ points
